narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Twelve vehicles passed, because the bar is twelve units long.
<bookmark mark='crowd'/>But a single unit already stands for a hundred vehicles, which is a big crowd.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>The length of a bar is only a count of units, not a count of vehicles.

narration: <bookmark mark='rule'/>Read the scale first, and then multiply the length of the bar by it.
<bookmark mark='turn'/>Your turn. On a quiet road, one unit stands for ten vehicles. A bar is six units long. How many vehicles is that?
